# siyuan

> siyuan，软件工程师。这里记录客户端与 AI 应用开发、个人项目、研究笔记和旅行照片。

This is a personal portfolio, research notebook, and travel journal. The text editions below contain the same published content as the interactive website and require no JavaScript. They are public, human-readable editions, not private or extra resume material.

## Entry points

- [中文内容目录](/read/zh/index.html)
- [English content index](/read/en/index.html)
- [Structured content index](/read/index.json)
- [Complete text, both languages](/llms-full.txt)

## Reading notes

- Each HTML page links to its Markdown edition and language counterpart.
- English pages with Chinese-only bodies are explicitly labeled; sourceLanguage in the index records this.
- Project metrics are historical, with their original scope, units, and caveats. Architecture nodes, all metrics, demo modes, and demo stages are expanded as text.
- Demo flows are illustrative, not production integrations. Media descriptions are not complete video transcripts.
- Read the linked documents for content; this directory does not guarantee that every crawler will retrieve or index them.
